WITH RentalCounts AS (
    SELECT
        s.store_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.rental_date) AS rental_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.rental_date) AS rental_month,
        COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_id ORDER BY COUNT(r.rental_id) DESC) as rn
    FROM
        rental r
    JOIN
        staff st ON r.staff_id = st.staff_id
    JOIN
        store s ON st.store_id = s.store_id
    GROUP BY
        s.store_id,
        rental_year,
        rental_month
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    rental_year,
    rental_month,
    rental_count
FROM
    RentalCounts
WHERE
    rn = 1
ORDER BY
    store_id;
